concern.concern: The Definition starts with an arbitrary balanced sutured manifold and says: 'Two such fields are homologous when, outside some open ball in int M, they are homotopic'. Balanced manifolds here may be disconnected. On two disjoint product balls, take fields v, w, z with the fixed boundary values: w differs from v by one local Hopf modification in the first component, and z differs from w by one in the second. Then v is related to w and w to z, but v is not related to z: a single ball lies in one component, leaving a nontrivial relative Hopf difference in the other. Thus the stated relation is not transitive and does not define homology classes at this scope. The empty balanced manifold also has no ball witnessing reflexivity. The original [Juhász 2006, §4](https://msp.org/agt/2006/6-3/agt-v6-n3-p16-s.pdf) explicitly assumes connectedness before this definition. The actual knot exteriors are connected, but the general definition needs adjudication.
